summary.content:
Today's selection covers 55 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 32 on Artificial Intelligence and 8 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Rolls Out Advanced Security for ChatGPT Accounts
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Telegram Mini Apps abused for crypto scams, Android malware delivery
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, The Verge, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 19 articles published in the last 24 hours
